name: QG-I1756: A Merchant Call no-show rejection appears in the Kanban Rejected column
description:
Objective: QG-I1756: A Merchant Call no-show rejection appears in the Kanban Rejected column.
Preconditions: Open Bug regressions application with the configured test data.
Steps:
1. Open Bug regressions application.
2. QG-I1756: A Merchant Call no-show rejection appears in the Kanban Rejected column.
3. Observe the resulting state.
Expected: The invalid or unauthorized action is rejected and no unintended state change is made.
